text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6, which froze when scanning the bill of lading barcode. Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02 and confirmed the number again a few messages later in the same thread. Hollis is a member of that channel, so he could see it himself. I also pointed out that #8841 is a different ticket (West yard Door 2 double-booking), so the two don't get mixed up in the tracker.

The gbrain search was refused because its access token isn't tied to a member, so the answer comes only from channels Hollis belongs to. Someone with admin access on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope` for gbrain to work here.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09, and Tobias is a member of that channel, so he could see it himself. I also passed on Hollis's caution from the same message: the import file labels the doors E1/E2 while Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that sorted out before anyone reimports, because reimporting as-is would create duplicates.

I didn't search gbrain again; it refused the last search because its access token isn't tied to any member.
